subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation formally reject `HOOK.md` files that exceed 1 MiB or are not stable regular files, matching the related workspace hardening?
rationale: The implementation is correct, but it deliberately tightens inputs accepted by the shipped installer and no existing public hook metadata limit establishes that compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept hardened contract
options.body: Adopt stable regular files up to 1 MiB as the hook metadata contract across install and workspace paths.

options.title: Preserve broader compatibility
options.body: Revise the read boundary to retain any intentionally supported oversized or in-root symlink metadata behavior while still preventing unbounded allocation.

recommendation.title: Accept hardened contract
recommendation.body: Adopt stable regular files up to 1 MiB as the hook metadata contract across install and workspace paths.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and primarily maintains this hook installation surface and is the current assignee.
